description: AMD Kintex-7 GTX transceivers at 10.3125 Gb/s (the 10GBASE-R line rate) from a 156.25 MHz reference: the quad's QPLL and one to four channels with the GT wizard's 10GBASE-R settings, GateLab's reset sequence with retries, the GTX's own PRBS31 generator and checker with error counts, near-end loopback, and the 64B/66B gearbox's 64-bit interface for a PCS — a block a cycle at 161.13 MHz, the user clocks from an MMCM per direction. Kintex-7 only. A simulation stand-in takes the transceivers' place in Icarus.

de.description: GTX-Transceiver des AMD Kintex-7 mit 10,3125 Gb/s (die Leitungsrate von 10GBASE-R) aus einem 156,25-MHz-Referenztakt: die QPLL des Quads und ein bis vier Kanäle mit den 10GBASE-R-Einstellungen des GT-Wizards, GateLabs Reset-Ablauf mit Wiederholungen, der eigene PRBS31-Generator und -Prüfer des GTX mit Fehlerzählern, Near-End-Loopback und die 64-Bit-Schnittstelle der 64B/66B-Gearbox für eine PCS — ein Block je Takt bei 161,13 MHz, die Benutzertakte aus einem MMCM je Richtung. Nur Kintex-7. In Icarus vertritt ein Simulationsmodell die Transceiver.
de.name: GTX-10G-Transceiver

name: GTX 10G Transceivers

parameters.description: Transceivers in the quad, 1 to 4 (the port widths here are for 2)
parameters.name: CHANNELS

parameters.description: TX swing (TXDIFFCTRL, 4 bits); 8 (4'b1000) is about 810 mV differential
parameters.name: TX_DIFF_CTRL

parameters.description: Milliseconds of PRBS errors in a row before a receiver is reset again
parameters.name: RETRY_MS

parameters.description: Cycles of clk per millisecond, CLK_HZ / 1000 (a testbench shortens it)
parameters.name: MS_CYCLES

parameters.description: Simulation only: 1 = channel 0 and 1 receive each other's words (a fibre between two cages)
parameters.name: SIM_CROSS

ports.description: Free-running clock for the reset sequence and the status (CLK_HZ)
ports.name: clk

ports.description: On clk: start the whole reset sequence again
ports.name: reset

ports.description: 156.25 MHz reference + (the quad's MGTREFCLK0P ball)
ports.name: refclk_p

ports.description: 156.25 MHz reference − (MGTREFCLK0N)
ports.name: refclk_n

ports.description: Transmit + per channel (MGTXTXP)
ports.name: txp

ports.description: Transmit − per channel (MGTXTXN)
ports.name: txn

ports.description: Receive + per channel (MGTXRXP)
ports.name: rxp

ports.description: Receive − per channel (MGTXRXN)
ports.name: rxn

ports.description: On clk: the QPLL is locked
ports.name: qpll_lock

ports.description: On clk: the transmitters are out of reset
ports.name: tx_ready

ports.description: On clk: each receiver is out of reset and monitored
ports.name: rx_ready

ports.description: On clk: receiver resets per channel, 16 bits each
ports.name: rx_retries

ports.description: A rising edge resets that channel's receiver (a PCS that lost block lock; from any clock, held 3 clk cycles)
ports.name: rx_restart

ports.description: PRBS31 on the transmitters and the checkers; counts errors and retries after 100 bad milliseconds
ports.name: prbs

ports.description: Each transmitter feeds its own receiver inside the chip (near-end PMA loopback)
ports.name: near_loopback

ports.description: 0: DFE equaliser (held after adapting), 1: LPM
ports.name: lpm

ports.description: Invert a receiver's polarity
ports.name: rx_invert

ports.description: On clk: PRBS error words per channel since prbs_clear, 32 bits each
ports.name: prbs_errors

ports.description: On clk: a pulse starts prbs_errors from 0
ports.name: prbs_clear

ports.description: Transmit block clock, 161.13 MHz (TXUSRCLK2, from an MMCM)
ports.name: tx_clk

ports.description: On tx_clk: the gearbox's sequence counter, 0 to 32, a block a cycle (no data at 32)
ports.name: tx_sequence

ports.description: On tx_clk: a 64B/66B block's 64 data bits per channel
ports.name: tx_data

ports.description: On tx_clk: each block's 2-bit sync header per channel
ports.name: tx_header

ports.description: Each channel's receive block clock, 161.13 MHz (from its recovered clock through an MMCM)
ports.name: rx_clk

ports.description: On rx_clk[n]: a received block's 64 data bits per channel
ports.name: rx_data

ports.description: On rx_clk[n]: each block's sync header per channel
ports.name: rx_header

ports.description: On rx_clk[n]: rx_data carries a block (low one cycle in 33)
ports.name: rx_data_valid

ports.description: On rx_clk[n]: rx_header is valid (with each block)
ports.name: rx_header_valid

ports.description: On rx_clk[n]: a pulse moves the block boundary by one bit
ports.name: rx_slip
